name: @activepieces/piece-useinbox
description: Email marketing and transactional email automation with INBOX (useinbox.com). Manage contacts, lists, campaigns, and react to delivery events.

auth.description:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.

username.description: The email address you sign in to INBOX with.

add_contact_to_list.name: add_contact_to_list
add_contact_to_list.description: Adds a single contact to an INBOX contact list. Creates the contact if the email is new, otherwise updates the existing contact and ensures it is part of the list.

auth.description:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.

username.description: The email address you sign in to INBOX with.

listId.description: Select the INBOX contact list. Lists are managed under Contacts > Lists in your dashboard.

email.description: Email address of the contact to add (e.g. jane@example.com).

aiMetadata.description: Adds a contact (by email) to a specific INBOX contact list, creating the contact if the email is new or updating it if it already exists, and ensuring list membership. Use to subscribe or enroll someone into a list. Requires a target list id and an email address; the upsert is keyed on the email so repeating with the same email and list yields the same membership without creating duplicates.

create_contact_list.name: create_contact_list
create_contact_list.description: Creates a new contact list in INBOX where you can later add contacts.

listName.description: Name of the new contact list (e.g. "Newsletter Subscribers").

auth.description:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.

username.description: The email address you sign in to INBOX with.

groupId.description: Optional. Place the list inside this group to keep things organised. Leave empty to keep it ungrouped.

legislation.description: Legal basis for collecting these contacts. Pick the regulation your audience is covered by; this affects what consent text INBOX shows.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new, empty contact list in INBOX that contacts can later be added to. Use when a list does not yet exist and one is needed before enrolling contacts; optionally nest it under a group and tag it with a consent legislation basis (GDPR, CASL, CAN-SPAM, or none). Requires a list name. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate list even if the name matches an existing one.

update_contact.name: update_contact
update_contact.description: Updates an existing INBOX contact. You can add or replace tags and set custom field values.

auth.description:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.

username.description: The email address you sign in to INBOX with.

contactId.description: Select the contact to update. Contacts are listed under Contacts in your INBOX dashboard.

tags.description: Optional. Tags to attach to the contact (e.g. "vip", "newsletter"). Leave empty to keep existing tags.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing INBOX contact identified by its contact id, setting its tags. Use to modify a known contact rather than create one. Requires the contact id; applying the same tags again leaves the contact in the same state.

unsubscribe_contact.name: unsubscribe_contact
unsubscribe_contact.description: Changes a contact status to Unsubscribed so they stop receiving campaigns from INBOX. You can also mark them as Hard Bounce or Spam Reported.

auth.description:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.

username.description: The email address you sign in to INBOX with.

contactId.description: Select the contact to update. Contacts are listed under Contacts in your INBOX dashboard.

status.description: The status to apply to the contact.

aiMetadata.description: Sets an existing INBOX contact's deliverability status, defaulting to Unsubscribed so they stop receiving campaigns; the status can instead be set to Hard Bounce or Spam Reported. Use to suppress a contact or record a deliverability outcome. Requires the contact id; setting the same status again is a no-op.

create_campaign.name: create_campaign
create_campaign.description: Schedules an INBOX campaign that sends a saved newsletter to one or more contact lists.

auth.description:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.

username.description: The email address you sign in to INBOX with.

senderAccountId.description: The verified sender the campaign emails are sent from. Add senders under Settings > Senders in INBOX.

newsletterId.description: The ID of the saved newsletter to send in the campaign. You can find newsletter IDs by using the "List Newsletters" action or by looking at the URL when editing a newsletter in INBOX (e.g. https://app.inboxroad.com/newsletters/12345/edit, where 12345 is the newsletter ID).

auth.description:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.

username.description: The email address you sign in to INBOX with.

lists.description: Select one or more INBOX contact lists. Lists are managed under Contacts > Lists in your dashboard.

plannedTime.description: Optional. When to send the campaign. Leave empty to use INBOX defaults. Use a future date/time.

notifyWhenStart.description: If enabled, INBOX emails you when the campaign starts sending.

notifyWhenEnd.description: If enabled, INBOX emails you when the campaign finishes sending.

aiMetadata.description: Creates and schedules an INBOX campaign that sends an existing saved newsletter from a verified sender to one or more contact lists, optionally at a future planned time. Use to broadcast a newsletter to lists. Requires a sender, a newsletter id, and at least one target list; the newsletter must already exist. Not idempotent: each call creates a new campaign.

send_transactional_email.name: send_transactional_email
send_transactional_email.description: Sends a one-off transactional email through INBOX Notify (e.g. password reset, receipt, welcome).

fromName.description: The display name shown to recipients (e.g. "Acme Support").

fromEmail.description: Verified sender email. The domain must already be authenticated in INBOX Notify, otherwise the email will be rejected.

htmlContent.description: The HTML body of the email. You can reference INBOX merge fields with `#fieldName#` and provide values in Custom Fields below.

customFields.description: Optional. Key-value pairs that replace `#key#` placeholders in your HTML (e.g. `{ "name": "Jane", "code": "12345" }`).

aiMetadata.description: Sends a single one-off transactional HTML email to one recipient through INBOX Notify, for messages like password resets, receipts, or welcome emails. Use for direct triggered email rather than list campaigns. Requires from name, from email, recipient, subject, and HTML body; the from-email domain must already be authenticated in INBOX Notify. Optional merge-field values replace #key# placeholders in the HTML. Not idempotent: each call sends another email.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.

username.description: The email address you sign in to INBOX with.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.

username.description: The email address you sign in to INBOX with.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_contact.name: new_contact
new_contact.description: Triggers when a new contact is added to your INBOX account (through a form, manual entry, import, or API).

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new contact appears in the INBOX account, regardless of how it was added (signup form, manual entry, import, or API). Represents a newly created contact record and emits its details.

new_campaign.name: new_campaign
new_campaign.description: Triggers when a new campaign is created in your INBOX account.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new campaign is created in the INBOX account. Represents a newly created campaign record and emits its details.

email_bounced.name: email_bounced
email_bounced.description: Triggers when a transactional email permanently bounces (hard bounce) — the recipient address does not exist or is blocked.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a transactional email sent through INBOX Notify hard-bounces, meaning the recipient address is permanently undeliverable (does not exist or is blocked). Represents a permanent delivery failure for a specific message and recipient.

email_spam_reported.name: email_spam_reported
email_spam_reported.description: Triggers when a recipient marks a transactional email as spam in their inbox.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a recipient marks a transactional email sent through INBOX Notify as spam. Represents a spam complaint for a specific message and recipient.

email_opened.name: email_opened
email_opened.description: Triggers each time a transactional email is opened by the recipient. Fires on every open (not unique).

aiMetadata.description: Fires each time a recipient opens a transactional email sent through INBOX Notify. Fires on every open, not only the first, so the same message and recipient can trigger it repeatedly.

email_clicked.name: email_clicked
email_clicked.description: Triggers when a recipient clicks a tracked link inside a transactional email.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a recipient clicks a tracked link inside a transactional email sent through INBOX Notify. Represents a link-click engagement event and emits the clicked URL; can fire multiple times for the same message and recipient.

nl.Email marketing and transactional email: E-mail marketing en transactionele e-mail automatisering met INBOX (useinbox.com). Beheer contacten, lijsten, campagnes en reactie op aflevergebeurtenissen.

Verbind uw INBOX-account door het e-mailadres en het wachtwoord in te voeren dat u gebruikt om in te loggen op https://app.useinbox.com.

Elke aanvraag geeft deze gegevens weer voor een kortstondig teken. zorg ervoor dat de inloggegevens behoren tot een gebruiker die toegang heeft tot de API.
nl.Adds a single contact to an INBOX contac: Voegt een enkele contactpersoon toe aan een lijst met INBOX contactpersonen. Maakt een contactpersoon aan als de e-mail nieuw is, anders wordt de bestaande contactpersoon bijgewerkt en verzekert u dat deze deel uitmaakt van de lijst.
nl.Creates a new contact list in INBOX wher: Maakt een nieuwe lijst met contactpersonen in INBOX waar je later contactpersonen kunt toevoegen.
nl.Updates an existing INBOX contact. You c: Werkt een bestaand INBOX-contact bij. U kunt labels toevoegen of vervangen en aangepaste veldwaarden instellen.
nl.Changes a contact status to Unsubscribed: Wijzigt de status van een contact aan uitgeschreven zodat ze stoppen met het ontvangen van campagnes van INBOX. Je kunt ze ook als Hard Bounce of Spam Reported markeren.
nl.Schedules an INBOX campaign that sends a: Plant een INBOX-campagne die een opgeslagen nieuwsbrief naar een of meer contactlijsten stuurt.
nl.Sends a one-off transactional email thro: Stuurt een eenmalige transactionele e-mail via INBOX Notify (bijv. wachtwoordreset, ontvangstbevestiging).
nl.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Maak een aangepaste API call naar een specifiek eindpunt
nl.Subject: Onderwerp
nl.Select the INBOX contact list. Lists are: Selecteer de lijst met contactpersonen. Lijsten worden beheerd onder Contactpersonen > Lijsten in uw dashboard.
nl.Email address of the contact to add (e.g: E-mailadres van de contactpersoon om toe te voegen (bijv. jane@example.com).
nl.Name of the new contact list (e.g. \"New: Naam van de nieuwe adresboek (bijv. "Nieuwsbrief abonnementen").
nl.Optional. Place the list inside this gro: Optioneel. Plaats de lijst in deze groep om dingen georganiseerd te houden. Laat leeg om het ongegroepeerd te houden.
nl.Legal basis for collecting these contact: Juridische basis voor het verzamelen van deze contacten. Kies de verordening die uw publiek bedekt is; dit heeft invloed op wat toestemmingstekst INBOX toont.
nl.Select the contact to update. Contacts a: Selecteer de contactpersoon om bij te werken. Contacten worden weergegeven onder Contacten in uw INBOX dashboard.
nl.Optional. Tags to attach to the contact: Optioneel. Tags om aan de contactpersoon toe te voegen (bijvoorbeeld "vip", "nieuwsbrief"). Laat leeg om bestaande tags te behouden.
De status die op de contactpersoon wordt toegepast.
nl.The verified sender the campaign emails: De geverifieerde afzender de campagne e-mails worden verzonden van. Voeg afzenders toe onder Instellingen > Afzenders in INBOX.
nl.The ID of the saved newsletter to send i: Het ID van de opgeslagen nieuwsbrief die in de campagne wordt verzonden. Je kunt nieuwsbrief-ID's vinden door de actie "Nieuwsbriefs" te gebruiken of door naar de URL te kijken bij het bewerken van een nieuwsbrief in INBOX (bv. . https://app.inboxroad.com/nieuwsbrief/12345/bewerking, waarbij 12345 de nieuwsbrief-ID is).
Selecteer een of meer INBOX contactlijsten. Lijsten worden beheerd onder Contacten > Lijsten in uw dashboard.
nl.Optional. When to send the campaign. Lea: Optioneel. Wanneer de campagne wordt verzonden. Laat leeg om INBOX standaard te gebruiken. Gebruik een toekomstige datum/tijd.
nl.If enabled, INBOX emails you when the ca: Indien ingeschakeld, e-mails die u ontvangt wanneer de campagne begint te verzenden.
Indien ingeschakeld, stuurt u INBOX e-mails wanneer de campagne klaar is met verzenden.
De weergavenaam getoond aan de ontvangers (bijv. "Acme Support").
nl.Verified sender email. The domain must a: Geverifieerde afzender-e-mail. Het domein moet al worden geverifieerd in INBOX Notify, anders zal de e-mail worden geweigerd.
nl.The HTML body of the email. You can refe: De HTML-inhoud van de e-mail. U kunt naar INBOX samenvoegvelden met `#fieldName#` verwijzen en waarden in Custom Fields hieronder opgeven.
nl.Optional. Key-value pairs that replace `: Optioneel. Key-waarde paren die `#key#` placeholders in je HTML vervangen (bijv. `{ "name": "Jane", "code": "12345" }`).
nl.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisatie headers worden automatisch geïnjecteerd vanuit uw verbinding.
Inschakelen voor bestanden zoals PDF's, afbeeldingen etc.

nl.Triggers when a new contact is added to: Triggert wanneer een nieuwe contactpersoon wordt toegevoegd aan je INBOX account (via een formulier, handmatige invoer, importeren of API).
nl.Triggers when a new campaign is created: Triggert wanneer een nieuwe campagne wordt aangemaakt in uw INBOX account.

de.Email marketing and transactional email: E-Mail-Marketing und transaktionale E-Mail-Automatisierung mit INBOX (useinbox.com). Verwalten Sie Kontakte, Listen, Kampagnen und reagieren Sie auf Liefertermine.
de.The email address you sign in to INBOX w: Die E-Mail-Adresse, mit der Sie sich bei INBOX anmelden.
de.Connect your INBOX account by entering t:
Verbinden Sie Ihr INBOX-Konto mit der E-Mail und dem Passwort, mit dem Sie sich auf https://app.useinbox.com anmelden.

Jede Anfrage tauscht diese Zugangsdaten gegen ein kurzlebiges Inhaber-Zeichen aus so stellen Sie sicher, dass die Anmeldedaten einem Benutzer gehören, der Zugriff auf die API hat.
de.Adds a single contact to an INBOX contac: Fügt einen einzigen Kontakt zu einer INBOX Kontaktliste hinzu. Erstellt den Kontakt, wenn die E-Mail neu ist, ansonsten aktualisiert den bestehenden Kontakt und stellt sicher, dass er Teil der Liste ist.
de.Creates a new contact list in INBOX wher: Erstellt eine neue Kontaktliste in INBOX, wo Sie später Kontakte hinzufügen können.
de.Updates an existing INBOX contact. You c: Aktualisiert einen bestehenden INBOX-Kontakt. Sie können Tags hinzufügen oder ersetzen und benutzerdefinierte Feldwerte festlegen.
de.Changes a contact status to Unsubscribed: Ändert den Kontakt-Status auf Abbestellt, damit sie Kampagnen von INBOX nicht mehr erhalten. Sie können diese auch als "Hard-Bounce" oder "Spam-Report" markieren.
de.Schedules an INBOX campaign that sends a: Plant eine INBOX-Kampagne, die einen gespeicherten Newsletter an eine oder mehrere Kontaktlisten schickt.
de.Sends a one-off transactional email thro: Sendet eine einmalige Transaktions-E-Mail über INBOX Notify (z.B. Passwort-Reset, Quittung, Willkommen).
de.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Einen benutzerdefinierten API-Aufruf an einen bestimmten Endpunkt machen
de.Notify when campaign starts: Benachrichtigen, wenn die Kampagne gestartet wird
de.Subject: Betreff
de.Select the INBOX contact list. Lists are: Wählen Sie die INBOX Kontaktliste aus. Listen werden unter Kontakte > Listen in Ihrem Dashboard verwaltet.
de.Optional. Place the list inside this gro: Optional. Platzieren Sie die Liste innerhalb dieser Gruppe, um die Dinge zu organisieren. Lassen Sie leer, um sie nicht zu verteilen.
de.Legal basis for collecting these contact: Rechtliche Grundlage für das Sammeln dieser Kontakte. Wählen Sie die Vorschrift, unter der Ihr Publikum erfasst; dies beeinflusst den Text der Einwilligung INBOX zeigt.
de.Select the contact to update. Contacts a: Wählen Sie den zu aktualisierenden Kontakt. Kontakte werden unter Kontakte in Ihrem INBOX-Dashboard aufgelistet.
de.Optional. Tags to attach to the contact: Optional. Tags zum Anhängen an den Kontakt (z.B. "vip", "Newsletter"). Leer lassen um bestehende Tags zu behalten.
Der Status der auf den Kontakt angewendet werden soll.
de.The verified sender the campaign emails: Der überprüfte Absender, von dem die Kampagnen-E-Mails gesendet werden. Fügen Sie Absender unter Einstellungen > Absender in INBOX hinzu.
de.The ID of the saved newsletter to send i: Die ID des gespeicherten Newsletters, der in der Kampagne gesendet werden soll. Sie finden die Newsletter-IDs über die Aktion "Newsletter" oder über die URL bei der Bearbeitung eines Newsletters in INBOX (e. . https://app.inboxroad.com/newsletters/12345/edit, wobei 12345 die Newsletter-ID ist).
Wählen Sie eine oder mehrere INBOX Kontaktlisten aus. Listen werden unter Kontakte > Listen in Ihrem Dashboard verwaltet.
de.Optional. When to send the campaign. Lea: Optional. Wenn die Kampagne gesendet wird. Leer lassen um INBOX Standardwerte zu verwenden. Verwenden Sie ein zukünftiges Datum/Zeit.
de.If enabled, INBOX emails you when the ca: Wenn aktiviert, werden Sie von INBOX E-Mails gesendet, wenn die Kampagne beginnt.
Wenn aktiviert, werden Sie von INBOX E-Mails gesendet, wenn die Kampagne beendet ist.
de.Verified sender email. The domain must a: Verifizierte Absender-E-Mail. Die Domain muss bereits in INBOX Notify authentifiziert werden, andernfalls wird die E-Mail abgelehnt.
de.The HTML body of the email. You can refe: Der HTML-Text der E-Mail. Sie können INBOX Merge Felder mit `#fieldName#` referenzieren und Werte in Custom Fields unten angeben.
de.Optional. Key-value pairs that replace `: Optional. Schlüsselwert-Paare, die `#key#` Platzhalter in deinem HTML ersetzen (z.B. `{ "name": "Jane", "code": "12345" }`).
de.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisierungs-Header werden automatisch von Ihrer Verbindung injiziert.
Aktivieren für Dateien wie PDFs, Bilder usw.
de.HEAD: HEAD
de.Triggers when a new contact is added to: Wird ausgelöst, wenn ein neuer Kontakt zu Ihrem INBOX-Konto hinzugefügt wird (durch Formular, manuelle Einträge, Import oder API).
de.Triggers when a new campaign is created: Wird ausgelöst, wenn eine neue Kampagne in Ihrem INBOX-Konto erstellt wird.
de.Triggers when a transactional email perm: Wird ausgelöst, wenn eine transaktionale E-Mail permanent abrupt (harter Abprall) — die Empfängeradresse existiert nicht oder wird blockiert.
de.Triggers when a recipient marks a transa: Löst aus, wenn ein Empfänger eine Transaktions-E-Mail als Spam in seinem Posteingang markiert.
de.Triggers each time a transactional email: Löst jedes Mal, wenn eine Transaktions-E-Mail vom Empfänger geöffnet wird. Feuert bei jeder offenen (nicht eindeutig) ab.
de.Triggers when a recipient clicks a track: Wird ausgelöst, wenn ein Empfänger einen Tracking-Link innerhalb einer Transaktions-E-Mail anklickt.

fr.Email marketing and transactional email: Gestion des contacts, listes, campagnes et réactions aux événements de livraison.
fr.The email address you sign in to INBOX w: L'adresse e-mail avec laquelle vous vous connectez à INBOX.
Mot de passe de votre compte INBOX.
fr.Connect your INBOX account by entering t:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.
fr.Add Contact to List: Ajouter un contact à la liste
fr.Adds a single contact to an INBOX contac: Ajoute un contact unique à une liste de contacts INBOX. Crée le contact si le courriel est nouveau, sinon il met à jour le contact existant et s'assure qu'il fait partie de la liste.
fr.Creates a new contact list in INBOX wher: Crée une nouvelle liste de contacts dans INBOX où vous pourrez ajouter des contacts plus tard.
fr.Updates an existing INBOX contact. You c: Met à jour un contact INBOX existant. Vous pouvez ajouter ou remplacer des tags et définir des valeurs de champs personnalisés.
fr.Changes a contact status to Unsubscribed: Modifie un statut de contact sur Désabonné afin qu'il cesse de recevoir des campagnes d'INBOX. Vous pouvez également les marquer comme un Hard Bounce ou Spam Reporté.
fr.Schedules an INBOX campaign that sends a: Planifie une campagne INBOX qui envoie une newsletter sauvegardée à une ou plusieurs listes de contacts.
fr.Sends a one-off transactional email thro: Envoie un e-mail transactionnel unique via INBOX Notify (ex: réinitialisation du mot de passe, reçu, bienvenu).
fr.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Passer un appel API personnalisé à un endpoint spécifique
fr.Notify when campaign starts: Notifier au démarrage de la campagne
fr.Notify when campaign ends: Notifier à la fin de la campagne
fr.Subject: Sujet
fr.Select the INBOX contact list. Lists are: Sélectionnez la liste de contacts INBOX. Les listes sont gérées sous Contacts > Listes dans votre tableau de bord.
fr.Email address of the contact to add (e.g: Adresse e-mail du contact à ajouter (par exemple jane@example.com).
fr.Name of the new contact list (e.g. \"New: Nom de la nouvelle liste de contacts (par exemple "Inscriptions à la Newsletter").
fr.Optional. Place the list inside this gro: Optionnel. Placez la liste à l'intérieur de ce groupe pour garder les choses organisées. Laissez vide pour le garder non groupé.
fr.Legal basis for collecting these contact: La base juridique pour la collecte de ces contacts. Choisissez le règlement par lequel votre public est couvert; cela affecte le texte de consentement que INBOX affiche.
fr.Select the contact to update. Contacts a: Sélectionnez le contact à mettre à jour. Les contacts sont listés sous Contacts dans votre tableau de bord INBOX.
fr.Optional. Tags to attach to the contact: Optionnel. Tags à attacher au contact (par exemple « vip», « newsletter»). Laisser vide pour conserver les tags existants.
Le statut à appliquer au contact.
fr.The verified sender the campaign emails: L'expéditeur vérifié envoie les courriels de la campagne. Ajouter les expéditeurs sous Paramètres > Expéditeurs dans INBOX.
fr.The ID of the saved newsletter to send i: L'ID de la newsletter enregistrée à envoyer dans la campagne. Vous pouvez trouver les identifiants de la newsletter en utilisant l'action "Lister les Newsletters" ou en regardant l'URL lors de l'édition d'une newsletter dans INBOX (e. . https://app.inboxroad.com/newsletters/12345/edit, où 12345 est l'ID de la newsletter).
Sélectionnez une ou plusieurs listes de contacts INBOX. Les listes sont gérées sous Contacts > Listes dans votre tableau de bord.
fr.Optional. When to send the campaign. Lea: Optionnel. Quand envoyer la campagne. Laisser vide pour utiliser INBOX par défaut. Utilisez une date / heure future.
fr.If enabled, INBOX emails you when the ca: Si activé, INBOX vous envoie des e-mails lorsque la campagne commence à envoyer.
Si cette option est activée, INBOX vous envoie des e-mails lorsque la campagne est terminée.
Le nom affiché aux destinataires (par exemple "Acme Support").
fr.Verified sender email. The domain must a: E-mail de l'expéditeur vérifié. Le domaine doit déjà être authentifié dans INBOX Notification, sinon l'e-mail sera rejeté.
fr.The HTML body of the email. You can refe: Le corps HTML de l'e-mail. Vous pouvez référencer les champs de fusion INBOX avec `#fieldName#` et fournir des valeurs dans les champs personnalisés ci-dessous.
fr.Optional. Key-value pairs that replace `: Optionnel. Les paires clé-valeur qui remplacent les marqueurs `#key#` dans votre HTML (par exemple `{ "name": "Jane", "code": "12345" }`).
fr.Authorization headers are injected autom: Les Headers d'autorisation sont injectés automatiquement à partir de votre connexion.
Activer pour les fichiers comme les PDFs, les images, etc.
fr.HEAD: HEAD
fr.Triggers when a new contact is added to: Déclenche lorsqu'un nouveau contact est ajouté à votre compte INBOX (par le biais d'un formulaire, d'une entrée manuelle, d'une importation ou d'une API).
fr.Triggers when a new campaign is created: Déclenche quand une nouvelle campagne est créée dans votre compte INBOX.

es.Email marketing and transactional email: Marketing por correo electrónico y automatización de correo electrónico transaccional con INBOX (useinbox.com). Administra contactos, listas, campañas, y reacciona a eventos de entrega.
es.The email address you sign in to INBOX w: La dirección de correo electrónico con la que inicia sesión en INBOX.
es.Connect your INBOX account by entering t:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.
es.Adds a single contact to an INBOX contac: Añade un solo contacto a una lista de contactos INBOX. Crea el contacto si el correo electrónico es nuevo, de lo contrario actualiza el contacto existente y se asegura de que forma parte de la lista.
es.Creates a new contact list in INBOX wher: Crea una nueva lista de contactos en INBOX donde puedes añadir contactos más tarde.
es.Updates an existing INBOX contact. You c: Actualiza un contacto INBOX existente. Puede agregar o reemplazar etiquetas y establecer valores de campos personalizados.
es.Changes a contact status to Unsubscribed: Cambia un estado de contacto a Darse de baja para que dejen de recibir campañas de INBOX. También puedes marcarlas como Rebotes Difíciles o Reportar Spam.
es.Schedules an INBOX campaign that sends a: Programe una campaña INBOX que envíe un boletín de noticias guardado a una o más listas de contactos.
es.Sends a one-off transactional email thro: Envía un email transaccional a través de INBOX Notify (por ejemplo, restablecimiento de contraseña, recibo, bienvenida).
es.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Hacer una llamada API personalizada a un extremo específico
es.Notify when campaign starts: Notificar cuando se inicie la campaña
es.Subject: Asunto
es.No Error on Failure: No hay ningún error en fallo
es.Select the INBOX contact list. Lists are: Seleccione la lista de contactos INBOX. Las listas se administran bajo Contactos > Listas en su panel de control.
es.Email address of the contact to add (e.g: Dirección de correo electrónico del contacto a añadir (ej. jane@ejemplo.com).
es.Name of the new contact list (e.g. \"New: Nombre de la nueva lista de contactos (por ejemplo, "Suscriptores de boletín").
es.Optional. Place the list inside this gro: Opcional. Coloca la lista dentro de este grupo para mantener las cosas organizadas. Dejar en blanco para mantenerla sin agrupar.
es.Legal basis for collecting these contact: Base legal para la recogida de estos contactos. Elija la regulación que su audiencia está cubierta por; esto afecta lo que muestra el texto de consentimiento INBOX.
es.Select the contact to update. Contacts a: Seleccione el contacto para actualizar. Los contactos se muestran bajo Contactos en su panel de control INBOX.
es.Optional. Tags to attach to the contact: Opcional. Etiquetas para adjuntar al contacto (por ejemplo, "vip", "newsletter"). Dejar en blanco para mantener las etiquetas existentes.
El estado a aplicar al contacto.
es.The verified sender the campaign emails: El remitente verificado del que se envían los correos electrónicos de la campaña. Añade remitentes en Ajustes > Enviados en INBOX.
es.The ID of the saved newsletter to send i: El ID del boletín de noticias guardado para enviar en la campaña. Puede encontrar los ID del boletín de noticias usando la acción "Listar boletines de noticias" o mirando la URL al editar un boletín en INBOX (e. . https://app.inboxroad.com/newsletters/12345/edit, donde 12345 es el ID del boletín de noticias).
Seleccione una o más listas de contactos INBOX. Las listas se administran bajo Contactos > Listas en su panel de control.
es.Optional. When to send the campaign. Lea: Opcional. Cuándo enviar la campaña. Deje en blanco para usar los valores predeterminados INBOX. Utilice una fecha y hora futuras.
es.If enabled, INBOX emails you when the ca: Si está activado, INBOX te envía correos cuando la campaña comienza a enviar.
Si está activado, INBOX te envía correos cuando la campaña finaliza el envío.
El nombre mostrado a los destinatarios (por ejemplo, "Soporte Acme").
es.Verified sender email. The domain must a: Correo electrónico del remitente verificado. El dominio ya debe estar autenticado en la notificación INBOX, de lo contrario el correo electrónico será rechazado.
es.The HTML body of the email. You can refe: El cuerpo HTML del correo electrónico. Puede hacer referencia a los campos INBOX combinados con `#fieldName#` y proporcionar valores en los campos personalizados a continuación.
es.Optional. Key-value pairs that replace `: Opcional. Pares de valor clave que reemplazan `#key#` marcadores de posición en tu HTML (por ejemplo, `{ "name": "Jane", "code": "12345" }`).
es.Authorization headers are injected autom: Las cabeceras de autorización se inyectan automáticamente desde tu conexión.
Activar para archivos como PDFs, imágenes, etc.
es.HEAD: LIMPIO
es.Triggers when a new contact is added to: Dispara cuando se agrega un nuevo contacto a su cuenta INBOX (a través de un formulario, entrada manual, importación o API).
es.Triggers when a new campaign is created: Dispara cuando se crea una nueva campaña en su cuenta INBOX.
es.Triggers when a transactional email perm: Se activa cuando un correo transaccional rebota permanentemente (rebote duro) — la dirección de destinatario no existe o está bloqueada.
es.Triggers when a recipient marks a transa: Dispara cuando un destinatario marca un correo transaccional como spam en su bandeja de entrada.
es.Triggers each time a transactional email: Dispara cada vez que un correo transaccional es abierto por el destinatario. Dispara cada apertura (no único).
es.Triggers when a recipient clicks a track: Se activa cuando un destinatario hace clic en un enlace rastreado dentro de un correo electrónico transaccional.

ja.Make a custom API call to a specific end: 特定のエンドポイントへのカスタム API コールを実行します。
ja.Scheduled Send Time: スケジュール送信時間
ja.Notify when campaign starts: キャンペーン開始時に通知する
ja.Notify when campaign ends: キャンペーン終了時に通知する

ja.Optional. Tags to attach to the contact: 任意です。連絡先に添付するタグ（例："vip"、"ニュースレター"）。既存のタグを維持するには空のままにしてください。

1つ以上の INBOX の連絡先リストを選択してください。リストはダッシュボードの format@@0 > format@@1 で管理されます。

zh.Email marketing and transactional email: Email marketing and transactional email automation with INBOX (useinbox.com). Manage contacts, lists, campaigns, and react to delivery events.
zh.The email address you sign in to INBOX w: The email address you sign in to INBOX with.
zh.Connect your INBOX account by entering t:
Connect your INBOX account by entering the email and password you use to sign in at https://app.useinbox.com.

Each request exchanges these credentials for a short-lived bearer token, so make sure the credentials belong to a user that has access to the API.
zh.Adds a single contact to an INBOX contac: Adds a single contact to an INBOX contact list. Creates the contact if the email is new, otherwise updates the existing contact and ensures it is part of the list.
zh.Creates a new contact list in INBOX wher: Creates a new contact list in INBOX where you can later add contacts.
zh.Updates an existing INBOX contact. You c: Updates an existing INBOX contact. You can add or replace tags and set custom field values.
zh.Changes a contact status to Unsubscribed: Changes a contact status to Unsubscribed so they stop receiving campaigns from INBOX. You can also mark them as Hard Bounce or Spam Reported.
zh.Schedules an INBOX campaign that sends a: Schedules an INBOX campaign that sends a saved newsletter to one or more contact lists.
zh.Sends a one-off transactional email thro: Sends a one-off transactional email through INBOX Notify (e.g. password reset, receipt, welcome).
zh.Make a custom API call to a specific end: 将一个自定义 API 调用到一个特定的终点
zh.Subject: Subject
zh.Select the INBOX contact list. Lists are: Select the INBOX contact list. Lists are managed under Contacts > Lists in your dashboard.
zh.Email address of the contact to add (e.g: Email address of the contact to add (e.g. jane@example.com).
zh.Name of the new contact list (e.g. \"New: Name of the new contact list (e.g. "Newsletter Subscribers").
zh.Optional. Place the list inside this gro: Optional. Place the list inside this group to keep things organised. Leave empty to keep it ungrouped.
zh.Legal basis for collecting these contact: Legal basis for collecting these contacts. Pick the regulation your audience is covered by; this affects what consent text INBOX shows.
zh.Select the contact to update. Contacts a: Select the contact to update. Contacts are listed under Contacts in your INBOX dashboard.
zh.Optional. Tags to attach to the contact: Optional. Tags to attach to the contact (e.g. "vip", "newsletter"). Leave empty to keep existing tags.
The status to apply to the contact.
zh.The verified sender the campaign emails: The verified sender the campaign emails are sent from. Add senders under Settings > Senders in INBOX.
zh.The ID of the saved newsletter to send i: The ID of the saved newsletter to send in the campaign. You can find newsletter IDs by using the "List Newsletters" action or by looking at the URL when editing a newsletter in INBOX (e.g. https://app.inboxroad.com/newsletters/12345/edit, where 12345 is the newsletter ID).
Select one or more INBOX contact lists. Lists are managed under Contacts > Lists in your dashboard.
zh.Optional. When to send the campaign. Lea: Optional. When to send the campaign. Leave empty to use INBOX defaults. Use a future date/time.
zh.If enabled, INBOX emails you when the ca: If enabled, INBOX emails you when the campaign starts sending.
If enabled, INBOX emails you when the campaign finishes sending.
The display name shown to recipients (e.g. "Acme Support").
zh.Verified sender email. The domain must a: Verified sender email. The domain must already be authenticated in INBOX Notify, otherwise the email will be rejected.
zh.The HTML body of the email. You can refe: The HTML body of the email. You can reference INBOX merge fields with `#fieldName#` and provide values in Custom Fields below.
zh.Optional. Key-value pairs that replace `: Optional. Key-value pairs that replace `#key#` placeholders in your HTML (e.g. `{ "name": "Jane", "code": "12345" }`).
zh.Authorization headers are injected autom: 授权头自动从您的连接中注入。
Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

zh.Triggers when a new contact is added to: Triggers when a new contact is added to your INBOX account (through a form, manual entry, import, or API).
zh.Triggers when a new campaign is created: Triggers when a new campaign is created in your INBOX account.
zh.Triggers when a transactional email perm: Triggers when a transactional email permanently bounces (hard bounce) — the recipient address does not exist or is blocked.
zh.Triggers when a recipient marks a transa: Triggers when a recipient marks a transactional email as spam in their inbox.
zh.Triggers each time a transactional email: Triggers each time a transactional email is opened by the recipient. Fires on every open (not unique).
zh.Triggers when a recipient clicks a track: Triggers when a recipient clicks a tracked link inside a transactional email.
